**Cause:** `importer.py:4` `normalize_email` only did `email.strip()`, so `USER7@Example.com` and `user7@example.com` were treated as different keys. `tests/test_importer.py:21-24` expects case-only differences to be duplicates, so it got 201 rows instead of 200.

Fixed `tests/test_ledger.py` failure by fixing `ledger.py:846`.

Root cause in `ledger.py:846-850` `periods_late()`: docstring says fee for “every 30-day period that has been started”, but code used floor division `days_late // 30`, so 1-29 days late returned `0` periods and `apply_late_fee()` in `ledger.py:1693` added no fee.

Fix: changed to ceiling division `math.ceil(days_late / 30)` (`math` already imported in `ledger.py:2`), so 1 day → 1 period, 30 days → 1, 45 days → 2.
